h1: Tajikistan tourist visa from the UK
intro: Planning a holiday or a visit to family or friends in Tajikistan? This page explains the Tajikistan tourist visa, who needs one and what to prepare. We check the rules for your passport and apply for you.
eligibility: You are travelling for a holiday, sightseeing or to visit family or friends
You won’t work or do business during your visit
You have a return ticket and enough money for your stay
documents: Passport photo page scan, valid for at least 6 months
Hotel booking, or an invitation from the people you’re visiting

sections.heading: Do you need a Tajikistan tourist visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Tajikistan, applied for online as an eVisa.

sections.heading: What a Tajikistan tourist visa covers
sections.text: A Tajikistan tourist visa is for holidays, sightseeing and visiting family or friends in Tajikistan. It doesn't cover business meetings or paid work. If you're travelling for business, see our [Tajikistan business visa](/tajikistan-business-visa-uk/) page.

sections.heading: UK residents on other passports
sections.text: UK residents on other passports usually apply the same way.

sections.heading: Tajikistan tourist visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Tajikistan tourist visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Tajikistan.

faqs.q: Can I visit family on a Tajikistan tourist visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Visiting family or friends is covered by the Tajikistan tourist visa.

faqs.q: Can I work in Tajikistan on a Tajikistan tourist visa?
faqs.a: No. Working needs a work visa or permit. Contact us and we’ll explain the options.

faqs.q: How long does a Tajikistan tourist visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.
